questions.question: What does Megumi do?
questions.subject: Megumi Fushiguro vs. Reggie Star's Group

answer.item: Megumi happens upon Remi soon after entering the Tokyo No. 1 Colony barrier

questions.question: What does Remi explain?
questions.subject: Megumi Fushiguro vs. Reggie Star's Group

answer.item: Remi explains why she chose this route for two reasons, claiming it's the simplest and that she has on the way

questions.question: What does Reggie do?
questions.subject: Megumi Fushiguro vs. Reggie Star's Group

answer.item: Reggie claps and commends Megumi's strength, claiming he's passed their test

questions.question: What does Megumi demand?
questions.subject: Megumi Fushiguro vs. Reggie Star's Group

answer.item: He demands that Reggie and his allies hand over all their points and states that only then will he consider joining them

questions.question: What does Chizuru Hari do?
questions.subject: Megumi Fushiguro vs. Reggie Star's Group

answer.item: Chizuru Hari suddenly dashes out of a corridor behind Megumi and tries to surprise attack him

questions.question: What does Megumi do to Hari?
questions.subject: Megumi Fushiguro vs. Reggie Star's Group

answer.item: Megumi lifts Hari above his head and throws him over the side of the building

questions.question: What does Hazenoki do?
questions.subject: Megumi Fushiguro vs. Reggie Star's Group

answer.item: Hazenoki throws three of his teeth at Megumi and Remi before detonating them, resulting in a massive explosion

questions.question: What does Megumi do next?
questions.subject: Megumi Fushiguro vs. Reggie Star's Group

answer.item: Megumi throws a high right kick that Hari blocks, but Megumi quickly follows up by summoning Max Elephant

questions.question: What happens?
questions.subject: Megumi Fushiguro vs. Reggie Star's Group

answer.item: However, a newcomer appears and takes the brunt of the explosion for Megumi

questions.question: Who is the newcomer?
questions.subject: Megumi Fushiguro vs. Reggie Star's Group

answer.item: The newcomer is Fumihiko Takaba, a player with zero points who tells everyone involved to be careful

questions.question: What does Takaba say?
questions.subject: Megumi Fushiguro vs. Reggie Star's Group

answer.item: Takaba just says "marry me and be my wi-fi"
